notes: This review uses public data from the China Passenger Car Association (CPCA), the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, customs figures and listed carmakers' filings to look back at China's new-energy passenger car market in Q3 2026 and propose our Q4 moves. CPCA's final September report is due in early October, so wherever September appears it is either the September 1–27 run rate or CPCA's September 17 forecast, and the page says which. The last page lists what management needs to decide.
